title: ESA/Gaia Milky Way face-on artist impression

license.attributionText: ‘The best Milky Way map by Gaia’ — ESA/Gaia/DPAC, Stefan Payne-Wardenaar, licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO. The source file was renamed locally; its pixels are unchanged.
license.changeNotice: The source JPEG was renamed locally to gaia-milky-way-face-on.jpg; image pixels are unchanged.

scientificCaveats: This face-on image is an artist’s impression based on Gaia data, not a photograph of the Milky Way seen from outside.
The COSMOS KIDS interactive spiral-arm geometry is a separate reconstruction informed by Reid et al. (2019), DOI 10.3847/1538-4357/ab4a11; it is not extracted from this image.
Spiral-arm boundaries and the Galaxy’s face-on appearance remain model-dependent and must not be presented as exact.
